Players Committee card image of [[Quietly Observing (V) (Playtest)]] — a '''Playtest''' image: published on 1 August 2019, the day before Virtual Set 11's official release (2 August 2019), and replaced on release day. Uploaded unchanged. (This file was first uploaded on 12 November 2026 as the original printing; Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 made pre-release images Playtest versions.)

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/quietlyobserving.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/quietlyobserving.gif] as of commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1” (1 August 2019).
